title: City station readings (hourly), NO2 and PM2.5
summary: Hourly NO2 (no2_ugm3) and PM2.5 (pm25_ugm3) concentrations from the city's own monitoring stations, keyed by station_id and UTC hour start (ts_utc). Catalog states about 4.2 million rows, temporal coverage from 2023-01-01 with no end date, and hourly refresh (last refreshed 2026-10-14). It covers the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 but not the prototype window (2004-2005). Access is by request to the Environment Monitoring Unit via warehouse SQL; no data sample was taken.

fields.name: no2_ugm3
fields.description: NO2 concentration, micrograms per cubic metre

fields.name: pm25_ugm3
fields.description: PM2.5 concentration, micrograms per cubic metre

schema.notes: No validation/QA flag, station location or station type column in the catalog schema.

spatial.code_system: station codes (free-text station_id); no coordinates or station register in catalog
spatial.notes: Valdena city network only (fictional client city, northern Italy). Station locations are not recorded in the catalog; wiki names VR-03 (Via Roma) only.

licence.name: internal

access.request_process: Request to the Environment Monitoring Unit (catalog access.request_process). Approval status and expected turnaround not stated.

documentation_excerpts: Hourly NO2 and PM2.5 readings from the city's own monitoring stations. (catalog description)
Station VR-03 (Via Roma) was switched off on 2024-06-30. Its readings stop there. (wiki station_network, last_edited 2024-07-01)
airq.station_readings still lists the network as active. Station VR-03 has no readings after 2024-06-30. (wiki station_network)
The other stations report continuously from 2023-01-01. (wiki station_network, last_edited 2024-07-01)
quality_notes: Status conflict: wiki station_network (last_edited 2024-07-01) says VR-03 was switched off 2024-06-30 and that the catalog still lists the network as active; the catalog entry (exported 2026-10-14) still shows status 'active' and temporal_coverage end null. The wiki is dated 2024-07-01, so the post-2024 state of the network is not confirmed by any source.
The wiki claim that other stations report continuously from 2023-01-01 is dated 2024-07-01 and has not been checked against the data; continuity through 2025 is unverified.
No QA/validation flag: validated versus provisional readings cannot be told apart.
No station register: station locations, types (traffic/urban/background) and station-to-traffic-counter mapping are not documented, so N2 linkage is not possible from this source alone.

Row count check: catalog row_count_approx 4.2 million. Over 2023-01-01 to 2026-10-14 (about 33,000 hours) this implies on the order of 125 station-hours per hour if rows are one per station-hour; the station count is not documented, so the figure cannot be reconciled and should be confirmed.
No sample was taken; the source is internal and only reachable by warehouse SQL after request, so types, sentinel values and negative values are unverified.
Prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04) is not covered: catalog temporal_coverage starts 2023-01-01.

provenance.claim: Source is an internal hourly NO2/PM2.5 station table owned by the Environment Monitoring Unit, steward Giulia Rossi, status active, refresh hourly, last refreshed 2026-10-14, temporal coverage 2023-01-01 to open-ended.
VR-03 switched off 2024-06-30; catalog still lists network as active; other stations report continuously from 2023-01-01.
Columns are station_id, ts_utc, no2_ugm3, pm25_ugm3; access via warehouse_sql with request to the Environment Monitoring Unit; no PII.
